available.quote: A professional or occupational licensing board shall issue a license to an applicant to allow the applicant to lawfully practice a profession or occupation requiring licensure in this state if the Wyoming licensing board determines that the applicant holds a relevant, active occupational or professional license in good standing from another state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a relevant, active license in good standing from another state with substantially equivalent or more stringent educational, training, examination and experience requirements; must demonstrate competency; must not have grounds for refusal/suspension/revocation; and must complete application procedures and pay fees. Note: 33-1-120(d)(ii) exempts professions with prescriptive drug authority from this section — dentists hold prescriptive authority so this general reciprocity provision may not apply; however, military expedited licensure is available under 33-1-117.

title_protection.quote: Who uses the words "dentist", "dental surgeon" or "oral surgeon", the letters "D.D.S.", "D.M.D." or any other words, letters, title or descriptive matter which in any way represents him as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of human teeth or jaws, or adjacent structures

scope_protection.quote: Except as provided by paragraph (xii) of this subsection, any person is deemed to be practicing dentistry within the meaning of this act: Who performs, or attempts, or advertises to perform, or causes to be performed by the patient or any other person, or instructs in the performance of any dental operation or oral surgery or dental service of any kind

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The person, firm or corporation receiving a work authorization from a licensed dentist shall retain the original work authorization and the dentist shall retain the duplicate copy for inspection at any reasonable time by the board or its authorized agents for two (2) years from date of issuance.
